scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), { execSync } = require('child_process'); fs.copyFileSync('index.dev.html', 'index.html'); execSync('tsc -b && vite build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', '404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'docs/index.html'); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'docs/assets', { recursive: true }); console.log('Build and deployment bundles synchronized!');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); execSync('git push origin main && git subtree push --prefix dist origin gh-pages', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
